calls.thesis: CoreWeave: $47B market cap on $7.6B TTM revenue; $35B debt; -$5.7B FCF in Q2 2026 alone; June 2026 8.5% notes now yielding >12%; negative ROIC. If debt markets close off, 'it is game over.'
'Definitely some cracks for Coreweave and Oracle'; worst debt-to-FCF in group at -7.9x; -30% since May. (Captions garble as 'Corvus'.)
